This is looking really nice — the library view is clean and easy to scan, and I can see titles, descriptions, tags, favorites, collections, sorting, and the search box all right there. That covers the "revisit and organize" side of what I want well.

The one thing I can't tell from this screen is the part that matters most: actually *saving* a new bookmark. Could you show me what happens when I click "Add bookmark" and paste in a link — does it save it into my library, and does it try to pull in the page's title so I don't have to type everything by hand? The six shown here look like they might be examples, so I'd like to see me adding a brand-new one and it sticking around.

Once I've seen a link go in and show up in the list, I'll be happy.
